content: On the Hour, Level Four (the illuminationists) also hold that the return is solely of the immortal spirit, a light attached to the darkness of the body which, like light reflected from a dark object, returns enhanced: before contact with matter it comprehends only universals, afterwards particulars too, until nothing remains unknown to it. They read Q 86:9 (the day when the secrets are tried) as referring to this level.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
